title: qa(checklist): records-forms — 60 ledger edits from the 18.2.0 release sweep (#25807)
body:
Filing gate: maintainer-directed task. Filed by the 18.2.0 release-assessment thread · `session_01G3h9iZTpL8aCiXbfsp8H5u`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not dispatched.

**Maintainer's words** (project thread, 2026-10-25, verbatim): 22:54Z 「约 300 条清单准确性问题：是不是应该开卡？」, then 22:55Z 「写issue，不派发」.

**Parent:** wave anchor #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep). RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (60)

### From #25812 — `priority:P0`, 23 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- `records-forms.crud-roundtrip`: the owner half of acc[6] says "not yet run" — it was replayed this run.

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `records-forms.action-param-widgets` ref-parse: the parent's pins include objectui e2e/live/action-modal.spec.ts, which the ref names only as DROPPED ('cited here until revision 3 … so it was dropped') — a parser false positive; it scores nothing here.
- `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` a4: the pin reproduces the filter on page.reload() and checks the URL param + record-count-bar '2' only — it never captures the data request the clause's network oracle names, nor compares row identity.
- `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` ref-parse: the parent's pins include objectui e2e/live/saved-view-filter.spec.ts, which the ref names only as dropped ('cited here until revision 5 … so it was dropped') — parser false positive.
- `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` a1/a4/n0: none of the three ref files exercises resolveBulkRows' paged fan-out or the HARD_CAP; the cross-page id resolution is unpinned even at component level
- `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` a3/n2: bulkActionRefresh.test.tsx '[#4140] bulk bar Clear resets both selection sources' asserts the behaviour in jsdom; the clause's dom/screenshot oracle needs the browser
- `records-forms.cascading-multilevel-and-clear` a1: the spec POSTs {country:'us', province:'zj'} where the verify names {country:'cn', province:'ca'}, and asserts code invalid_option only — the verify's message key option_unavailable is not checked; the in-set answer is 201, not the verify's 200.
- `records-forms.cascading-multilevel-and-clear` ref: rule-validator.option-visibility.test.ts is in the ref but by its own words scores no clause (validator layer) — the parent need not run it for this item.
- `records-forms.cascading-options` a1/n0: the pin is an objectui Playwright live spec (needs a live stack + console at the objectui pin); it scores only if the parent runs it against a booted showcase.
- `records-forms.comment-reactions-and-edit-stamps` a1/a2: sys-comment-reactions-door.integration.test.ts is named a 'door' test but boots ObjectKernel + ObjectQLPlugin over sqlite-wasm and maps errors with mapDataError — no HTTP adapter, so it cannot score the api clauses.
- `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict` a3: the ref scores acceptance[3] from occSave.test.tsx › 'ObjectForm edit — OCC guarded save › 409 → "overwrite" retries re-keyed to the server currentVersion and completes the save', but that case runs over a mocked data source, so it pins the client re-key only — not the clause's api oracle (the retry answered 200 and a re-read shows one winner)
- `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict` a1: occSave.test.tsx pins the modal Keep editing / Overwrite choice in jsdom; the dom oracle wants a rendered (screenshot-confirmed) dialog, and the inline ConcurrentUpdateDialog half has no pin
- `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict` pins: the parent's pin list includes objectui e2e/live/inline-edit-polish-2572.spec.ts, which the ref names only to say it was DROPPED at revision 4 (no If-Match, no conflict, stale at the pin) — a ref-parse over-inclusion; it scores no clause
- `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid` ref-parse over-inclusion: the parent's pins list carries objectui e2e/live/grid-file-upload.spec.ts, which the ref says was DROPPED at revision 8 and scores no clause — do not run it for this item
- `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid` all objectui pins are Playwright e2e/live specs needing a live stack; they can only score in a browser run, and even green they score halves only
- `records-forms.conditional-rules-header` a2: the ref claims field-conditional-rules.spec.ts pins 'acceptance[2]'s client lock … tax_rate's input giving way to the read-only field group at paid', but the spec asserts the OPPOSITE on the New dialog: at paid `taxRate` toBeEnabled() and the read-only group toHaveCount(0) (objectui#13436 — INSERT is exempt from readonlyWhen); no pin drives an edit form of a paid invoice
- `records-forms.conditional-rules-header` pins: the parent's pin list includes objectui e2e/live/list-row-action-cel.spec.ts, which the ref names only to say it was DROPPED at revision 3 (it gates the task list's Mark Done, not the invoice's Edit/Delete) — a ref-parse over-inclusion; it scores no clause
- `records-forms.conditional-rules-header` a0/a3: both pins are browser tests that read the DOM directly via Playwright locators (no screenshot step), which satisfies render-first only because Playwright waits for visibility
- `records-forms.delete-behavior-matrix` a0–a4/n0–n3: every pin is engine-level (ObjectQL over a test driver); precedent #24840 scored a0–a4, n0–n3 PASS from them before the layer rule — at the api oracle they score not-run until a REST pin exists.
- `records-forms.delete-behavior-matrix` a5: packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts ('deleteBehavior: set_null on master_detail is a parse-time rejection') pins the #9689 parse seam at schema level and is not in the ref; the verify's PUT refusal has no pin.
- `records-forms.encrypted-field-behavior` a0: the dogfood pin scores the masked-GET half only; the 'secret:<handle>' column / sys_secret ciphertext leg is asserted only in packages/objectql/src/secret-fields.test.ts at the engine layer (the verify makes that leg conditional on DB inspection)
- `records-forms.field-history-tracking` a2: objectui e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts (in the ref, claiming no clause) does open showcase_account's History tab, so it holds a2's flag-true half in a browser; the task-detail absence half has no pin
- `records-forms.field-type-constraints` a5/a6: ref says engine-lookup-referential-integrity / engine-autonumber-runtime-owned pin these; both drive ObjectQL in-process, not the /data door the api oracle names
- `records-forms.field-type-constraints` ref names field-zoo.matrix.ts — a data module, not a test file (correctly absent from pins)
- `records-forms.field-type-constraints` a0-a4: the ref's 'round-trip & masking' pin asserts only accepted vectors; none of the refusal codes (max_length, min_value, max_value, invalid_number, invalid_option, invalid_type) is pinned at any layer by the ref
- `records-forms.field-type-matrix` ref names field-zoo.matrix.ts (a vectors module, not a test file) — a ref parser must treat it as a fixture, not a pin; field-zoo-value-shape.test.ts (in pins) asserts no clause directly (write vectors parse under valueSchemaFor)
- `records-forms.field-type-matrix` a5/n1: ref implies relational coverage incl. #4441, but field-zoo-roundtrip only seeds real ids; no dangling-id refusal is asserted
- `records-forms.field-type-matrix` a4: f_autonumber is a 'present' check (non-null) — 'server-assigned' is inferred from it not being written
- `records-forms.field-unique-enforcement` a4: clause text says bare unique 'NULL-organization rows fold to ONE bucket' (ADR-0120 D3); both pins now assert the opposite — 'a row with NO organization is exempt — ... the D3 bucket retired' (memory) and 'on a pre-18 nullable column, rows with no organization are NOT constrained (ADR-0131 D1)' (SQL). The clause needs re-authoring; it cannot score pass from these pins as written
- `records-forms.field-unique-enforcement` a0-a3/n0-n2: ref correctly says no pin drives a REST door
- `records-forms.form-dirty-guard` a0/n0: discardGuard.test.tsx covers the X close + Cancel + pristine paths for ModalForm/DrawerForm, but no Escape or backdrop-click case
- `records-forms.form-dirty-guard` a2: the file holds 11 it() cases at the pin; the '14/14' cited from QA run #23163 will not match this tree's count
- `records-forms.gantt-interactions` a1/a2: ref maps these clauses to component/unit cases (cases exist at pin b41ed7f68956), but the clauses' oracle is api (row-set diffs / server reads) — the pins stop at the component's update callback and cannot score them
- `records-forms.gantt-interactions` ref names objectui commit 0abd4f9f8769 for the per-clause mapping; the run pin is b41ed7f68956 (the named cases are present there)
- `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel` a3: the ref says each spec covers acceptance[3] ('the job list read on undoable and revertedAt'); the specs read the list once before undo (filter undoable && !revertedAt) and confirm the revert only through the UI testid import-history-reverted-<id>, so 'revertedAt once a job is reverted' is never read off GET /import/jobs
- `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel` a1/n0: both specs count with an unfiltered GET /api/v1/data/<object> and read records.length — a page-bounded list length, not the clause's marker-filter count — and they self-skip (IMPORT_CONSOLE_LIVE / harness reachability) and default to crm_app/crm_lead, so a skip or a non-showcase target scores nothing
- `records-forms.import-wizard-encoding-and-hints` pins are objectui files (repo objectui → /home/claude/ou-pin); they score a0–a2 only when the objectui pin worktree's vitest runs them
- `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` a1: ref says saved-view-filter.spec.ts covers acceptance[1]; it asserts only that no showcase_task data response was >=400 and the count bar starts '2 ' — the AST filter param and the count-vs-response-total match are not captured
- `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` showcase-search.dogfood.test.ts is in the ref but, as the ref itself says, scores no clause of this item
- `records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save` pins list includes e2e/live/summary-rollup.spec.ts, but the ref states it was dropped at revision 5 and asserts no clause — a ref-parse over-capture (it names the file in prose)
- `records-forms.master-detail-atomic-save` a0: master-detail.spec.ts pins carrier-neutrally on showcase_project_workspace with one child; the two-line invoice payload and 'not N sequential writes' (batch count) remain the run's
- `records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle` a0: the pin drives POST /forms/contact-us/submit (anonymous, status 'closed' stripped), not POST /api/v1/data/showcase_inquiry omitting source/status as the verify names — the hook's 'web' stamp is engine-side so it scores, but the /data door itself is undriven
- `records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle` a6/n0: hook-error-format.dogfood.test.ts proves a throwing beforeDelete (hef_ref_guard, default onError) leaves the row; no pin drives a throwing beforeInsert POST
- `records-forms.object-hook-lifecycle` ref says the four objectql units ran '83 tests'; this tree has 79 it() cases across them (25+12+22+20) — count drift, not a missing file
- `records-forms.predicate-relationship-traversal` a3 is scored from an engine pin by the item's own knownGaps (no restricted persona on stock showcase) — a deliberate layer exception, not a rule-6 pass for an HTTP oracle
- `records-forms.record-clone-contract` ref says packages/rest/src/search-clone-route-schema-conformance.test.ts 'drives the live mount' — it calls the registered handler on RestServer(mockServer) with a mocked protocol whose cloneData returns a constant body; no HTTP adapter, no engine
- `records-forms.record-clone-contract` a3: the verify names 'the #7823 strip suite' but the ref names no such file; packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.write-response-internal-fields.tripwire.test.ts (enumerates cloneData) exists and is not in the ref
- `records-forms.record-clone-contract` ref spells files as 'packages/metadata-protocol — search-clone-schema-conformance.test.ts' (package + em dash + basename, no src/ path) — a strict path parser would miss both; the parent resolved them
- `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` a5: comments-permission-matrix '(f) enable.feeds:false still answers FEEDS_DISABLED' asserts 403 + code on its cmt_nofeeds fixture; it does not read the thread's zero rows after the refusal
- `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` a6/n3: capability-gate-update-verb.test.ts is engine-level (ObjectQL + installAuditWriters), as the clause itself says
- `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` a8: the clause names objectui recordActivityFeed.test.ts as a fallback oracle, but it is not in automated.ref (objectui), so a ref-driven run never executes it
- `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` a9: mention-recipient-gate.integration.test.ts is engine-level; the ref itself says partial at most
- `records-forms.record-edit-undo` UndoManager.test.ts tests only the in-memory undo/redo stack; it scores no clause of this item (none of the clauses is a stack-semantics clause) — the ref should say so explicitly
- `records-forms.view-type-gallery` a5: the pin is a Playwright spec (pnpm -C examples/app-showcase test:smoke) that needs a built console and a live stack — it scores only if the parent actually runs it; a vitest-only pin run leaves a5 not-run.
- `records-forms.write-answer-advisories-rollback-and-tree-delete` a1: advisory-write-answer.test.ts calls ObjectStackProtocolImplementation createData/updateData in-process — the REST PATCH body is not observed
- `records-forms.write-answer-advisories-rollback-and-tree-delete` a2/n0: engine-after-hook-abort-unit.test.ts drives ObjectQL directly; no HTTP pin for the aborting afterInsert
- `records-forms.write-answer-advisories-rollback-and-tree-delete` a3: scored on the referenceless tree fixture (rtl_*), not a showcase object — acceptable since the clause names no carrier

### From #25817 — `release-18.2.0-manual-set`, 29 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- records-forms.action-location-matrix:
  - The related-list header renders the list_toolbar Reassign…, as in 18.1.
  - The sidebar "More actions" shares its accessible name with the header ⋯, a click trap; scope the click to `main`.
  - The quick bar names its actions explicitly, so recalc_estimate is absent there by page authoring.

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
